pages.scan: Top full-width panel: caption top-left 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' A doctor in a white coat at the clinic door waves an elderly woman in a lilac sari inside. Two patients sit in the waiting chairs on the right (silent). Lower-left panel: the receptionist in a blue kurta talks on the phone and writes in a ledger next to a stack of books. Her balloons, both with tails to her: (1) top-left 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...' (2) right, lower 'I wish everything were easier to manage!' A sweat drop and stress marks show she is flustered. Patients' heads are in the foreground (silent). Lower-right panel: the doctor stands with her hand on her chin, watching the receptionist in the background, and says (tail to her) 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.'
pages.observation: The reading order is natural: caption, then left panel top balloon, then the lower-right balloon, then the right panel. Nothing seems skipped, and the problem-and-intention setup is clear. The doctor's name comes only from the caption. The panel-3 speaker is clearly the doctor, though her chin-hand pose reads like a thought rather than speech. The tail of 'Appointments...' is long and ends on the top of the receptionist's hair. The 'I wish...' tail ends just above her head. 'details,' and 'belongs' sit close to the right edges of their balloons, but they look inside at the displayed size. No lettering covers a face.

pages.scan: Top panel: caption at top centre 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.' Label top-right 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic'. Dr. Ananya types on a laptop that shows an onboarding stepper, in sunset light. Middle-left: Ananya, hand on chin, says (tail to her) 'We can organise our clinic workflow here.' Middle-right: the receptionist holds up a phone with a calendar app and says (tail to her) 'And our team can use tools suited to each staff role.' Label lower in this panel: 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff'. Bottom wide panel: Ananya at the laptop makes a small fist and says (tail to her) 'One team. Better coordination.' The receptionist stands to the right, smiling and holding her phone (silent).
pages.observation: The order is natural: caption, label, middle-left, middle-right, bottom. The exchange reads as a continuous conversation. The caption box in panel 1 sits flush against the top panel border. The 'WELBUK CARE' label overlaps the receptionist's left side, lower arm and hip area. 'here.' and 'role.' sit tight against the right edges of their balloons, and 'staff' is tight against the label's right edge. In panels 2 and 4 the tails end at Ananya's hair near her temple or cheek. Because labels sit next to each person, a reader takes it that Practice goes with the doctor and Care with the staff or receptionist. This mapping matters later (see page 08).

pages.scan: Top-left: caption 'A later morning: patients can always check in at the front desk.' An elderly man with a cane at the desk talks with the smiling receptionist (silent). Top-right: caption 'Some check in ahead on the Welbuk Health app.' A young woman in a red kurta taps her phone outside the clinic (silent). Middle-left: caption 'Ravi scans the QR code at the door.' A bearded man in a green shirt scans a QR stand with his phone. Middle-right: caption 'A short form on his own phone, shared with consent.' A close-up of his hands and a phone form with a check icon. Bottom wide panel: caption 'Every check-in gets a slot on the screen.' Wall screen 'A-10 · A-11 · A-12'. The elderly man, the young woman and Ravi sit in the waiting chairs and look up at the screen (silent).
pages.observation: The panel order is clear: top-left, top-right, middle-left, middle-right, bottom. The three check-in methods (desk, app, QR) read clearly. Ravi is introduced by name in a caption only, which works. The top-right caption box is flush with the panel's top and right borders. The screen does not show which slot belongs to whom. That is acceptable because page 04 resolves A-12 as Ravi's. No lettering covers faces or hands.

pages.scan: Top panel: caption 'Soon, his slot comes up.' Screen 'NOW · A-12'. Ravi stands up from the waiting chairs, looking up and smiling. The receptionist is at the desk in the background (silent). Lower-left: caption 'A quick vitals check first.' A nurse in lilac scrubs pumps a blood-pressure cuff on Ravi's arm and says (tail to her) 'Hi, Ravi! Just relax your arm for me.' Ravi smiles (silent). Lower-right: caption 'Dr. Ananya is notified when he's ready.' Ananya looks at a tablet that shows a check mark and a label 'RAVI · READY'.
pages.observation: The order is natural: top, then lower-left caption, then balloon, then lower-right. The sequence (slot called, vitals, doctor notified) is clear. The nurse is a new, unnamed character but her role is obvious. Her balloon tail ends on the top of her hair. The on-screen label breaks as 'RAVI ·' on one line and 'READY' on the next. The trailing dot at a line end looks slightly awkward. The label's right edge comes very close to Ananya's right-hand fingers on the tablet.

pages.scan: Top panel: Ananya at her desk opens her hand towards Ravi and says (tail to her) 'Hello, Ravi. Tell me what brings you in.' Ravi sits relaxed in a chair (silent). Info label lower-left over the laptop: 'PATIENT DETAILS: current vitals · prior health info · allergy panel · AI mic option · patient docs · lab reports'. Middle wide panel, small figures: Ananya, tail to her: 'May the AI listen and save notes of our talk?' Then Ravi, tail to him on the right: 'Yes, I agree.' Label at right: 'AI VOICE CONSENT: asked at the first visit, before any voice is saved'. The laptop shows a mic and shield icon. Lower-left: Ravi, hand on his neck, says (tail to him) 'I've been feeling tired lately.' Label: 'SOAP NOTES: fill in manually and choose ICD or SNOMED codes, or let AI listen and summarise the conversation'. A glowing mic icon is on the laptop screen. Lower-right: caption 'Technology supports the workflow. The conversation stays human.' Ananya listens with a gentle smile. Ravi is seen from behind (silent).
pages.observation: The dialogue order is readable: greeting, consent question, 'Yes, I agree.', complaint. The top balloon is higher than the left label, so it is read first. However, the long PATIENT DETAILS label on the left competes for first attention. In the middle panel the two balloons almost touch each other, and Ravi's tail runs a long diagonal across empty space. The answer is not skipped. The AI VOICE CONSENT label touches the panel's right border. 'visit,' and 'saved' are tight against its right edge. In the SOAP NOTES label, 'conversation' is tight against the label edge. That label also covers the left part of the laptop. The page is heavy with UI text: three info labels and one caption. The feature lists slow the doctor–patient scene, and a reader may skim them. Ravi's 'feeling tired' line gets no reply on this page. The next page gives one. The Ravi and Ananya tails touch their hair or heads, not their faces.

pages.scan: Top panel: a laptop screen close-up with the header 'SPECIALITY-SPECIFIC TREATMENT PLANNER'. Three cards with labels: 'Dentist: odontogram', 'Eye doctor: eye markers', 'Paediatrician: growth scales · vaccines'. A doctor's hand is on the trackpad. Bottom panel: Ananya gestures to Ravi and says (tail to her) 'We'll go through your concerns and decide the right next steps together.' Ravi listens, smiling (silent). Label lower-left over the laptop: 'PLAN OF CARE: intelligent prescribing · summary · drug interactions · labs · referrals'.
pages.observation: The order is clear: top screen, then bottom balloon, then label. The balloon works as the reply to Ravi's 'I've been feeling tired lately' on page 05. The top panel is a story non sequitur: Ravi complained of tiredness, but the planner shows dentist, eye-doctor and paediatric tools. It reads as a product feature insert, not part of his consultation. The Paediatrician label runs past the screen onto the bezel and keyboard edge, and the labels cover the bottoms of their screen cards. Ananya's balloon tail ends at her hair near her cheek. The PLAN OF CARE label covers most of the laptop but no hands or faces.

pages.scan: Top panel: at the front desk, the receptionist points at Ravi's phone and says (tail to her) 'Welbuk Health is designed to help patients stay connected with their care.' Ravi looks at his phone (silent). Middle-left: Ravi holds up his phone showing a calendar and heart app and says (tail to him) 'So I can keep useful information in one place?' Label: 'WELBUK HEALTH for patients'. Middle-right: the receptionist gestures towards Ravi's phone and says (tail to her) 'That's the idea. Let's walk through what is available to you.' Bottom wide panel: caption 'A smoother visit. A more connected experience.' Ravi walks out, waving. Ananya and the receptionist wave back from the clinic door (silent).
pages.observation: The order is natural: statement, question, answer, farewell caption. The exchange is easy to follow. The move from the consultation room (page 06) to the front desk is not marked by a caption, but the setting change is readable from the art. The top tail ends at the receptionist's hair beside her eye or temple, very close to her face. Ravi's tail ends at his hair. The WELBUK HEALTH label overlaps a background monitor only. The bottom caption box is long and runs close to the awning. It does not cover a figure.

pages.scan: Top-left: caption 'Meanwhile, the pharmacy is notified and fills the prescription.' Label 'NEW PRESCRIPTION'. A moustached pharmacist puts a box into a paper bag, and a tablet shows a pill icon (silent). Top-right: caption 'The lab is notified.' Label 'LAB ORDER: samples to collect'. A lab technician in glasses holds a sample tube (silent). Middle wide panel: caption 'Later that day, Ravi gives his samples at the clinic lab.' Ravi sits in a phlebotomy chair pressing cotton to his arm. The lab technician says (tail to her) 'All done, Ravi! We'll let you know when your results are ready.' Bottom-left tall panel: caption 'Results ready: Ravi is notified.' Label 'Welbuk Health app · email · WhatsApp'. Ravi on a sofa at home looks at his phone, which shows a check (silent). Bottom-right upper: caption 'Dr. Ananya is notified on Welbuk Care.' Label 'RESULTS READY'. Ananya holds a tablet with a test-tube and check icon. Bottom-right lower: caption 'The clinic is notified on Welbuk Practice.' Label 'RESULTS READY'. The receptionist works at a monitor that shows a check.
pages.observation: The panel order works: top-left, top-right, middle, then the bottom-left tall panel, then the right upper and right lower panels. Product-mapping inconsistency: on page 02, Welbuk Practice was shown with Ananya ('for the clinic') and Welbuk Care with the receptionist ('for clinic staff'). Here Ananya is notified 'on Welbuk Care' and the receptionist or clinic 'on Welbuk Practice'. This reverses the mapping a reader formed on page 02 and confuses which product is which. Time logic: page 07 ended with Ravi leaving and waving goodbye, yet 'Later that day' he is back at the clinic lab. This is plausible but a little jarring right after the farewell. 'Meanwhile' also sits loosely against the page-07 farewell. The top-left caption box is flush with the panel's top border and its right edge sits right against the pharmacist's hair. 'fills' is tight against the box edge. The top-right caption box is flush with the panel's top and right borders. The lab technician's balloon is close to her head, and its tail ends at her hair bun. The bottom-right panels each stack a caption and a label, which is repetitive ('RESULTS READY' twice) but legible.

pages.scan: Top-left: caption 'Tomorrow, care may take us beyond our hometown.' Ravi sits on a train by the window, smiling, with his phone (silent). Top-right: label 'WELBUK VISION'. Caption 'The vision: trusted connections between clinics, specialists, and patients across locations.' A grey-haired doctor in front of a clinic gestures towards it. Dotted lines connect clinic icons in the sky (silent). Middle wide panel: label 'WELBUK VISION'. Caption 'One connected ecosystem for care and family wellness.' Ravi, a woman in a yellow kurta and a boy look at a tablet with family icons and a heart (silent). Bottom panel: label top-right 'Welbuk Practice • Welbuk Care • Welbuk Health'. The receptionist, Ananya and a waving Ravi stand in front of the clinic. Caption bottom-left 'Welbuk — Building a connected healthcare ecosystem.'
pages.observation: The order is clear: top-left, top-right (label then caption), middle (label then caption), bottom (top-right label, then the bottom-left caption). Reading the bottom panel's lower-left caption after the upper-right label is natural enough. 'Tomorrow, care may take us beyond our hometown' has an unclear 'us': no narrator has been established, and it is not tied to Ravi's voice. The grey-haired doctor, and Ravi's wife and son, are new and unintroduced. As a vision montage it is understandable, but who they are is left implicit. The 'WELBUK VISION' label is repeated in two consecutive panels. The top-right label is flush with the panel's top border. The bottom label's left edge comes very close to Ravi's head and hair on the right side. The bottom caption's right edge appears to overlap the lower edge of Ananya's dress or legs, and to come close to the receptionist's feet. The bullet separator '•' here differs from the '·' used elsewhere. Overall the ending is a promotional summary, not a story beat, but it is clear.
